summary: SES S.A. filed a 6-K with a press release covering Q1 2026 earnings, reporting revenue of €847M (up 80.5% y/y) and adjusted EBITDA of €404M, reiterating full-year outlook. The filing notes Intelsat’s full consolidation post-July 2025, a €650M SPACE hybrid issuance (5x oversubscribed), O3b mPOWER satellite service commencement, and an AGM-approved dividend. No M&A, activist, strategic review, tender, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change event is present. This is a routine earnings report, not a special situation.
